title: A.e.-measurability of x ↦ ‖L(x)_#ξ(x)‖ₑ
statement: For all P, Q, n ∈ ℕ, every measure μ on ℝ^P, and all L : ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^Q) and ξ : ℝ^P → NVector(ℝ^P, n) that are μ-a.e. strongly measurable, the function x ↦ ‖nVectorPushforward n (L x) (ξ x)‖ₑ is μ-a.e. measurable.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (L : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q)) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), AEStronglyMeasurable L μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → AEMeasurable (fun x => ‖nVectorPushforward n (L x) (ξ x)‖ₑ) μ
